en: Sura 38: Sad
ja: 第38章 サード章

p.src: 38:1  Sād[1]. By the Qur’an, full of reminder[2],

en: Sād[1]. By the Qur’an, full of reminder[2],
ja: サード[1]。教訓を含むクルアーン*に誓って。
u.src: 38:1  Sād[1]. By the Qur’an, full of reminder[2],

en:
[1] See footnote 2:1.
 [2] The oath's completion is that the Qur’an is inimitable and thus Allah's miracle.
ja: [1]　この文字については、頻出名・用語解説の「クルアーン*の冒頭に現れる文字群*」を参照。

p.src: 38:2  yet those who disbelieve are in arrogance and dissension.

en: yet those who disbelieve are in arrogance and dissension.
ja: いや、不信仰に陥った者*たちは、（真理に対する）尊大さと対立の中にある。
u.src: 38:2  yet those who disbelieve are in arrogance and dissension.

p.src: 38:3  How many generations have We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late for deliverance.

en: How many generations have We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late for deliverance.
ja: われら*は彼ら（シルク*の徒）以前にも、どれだけの（不信仰な）世代を滅ぼしてきたか。彼らは（懲罰が訪れて）救いがなくなった時、（救いと悔悟の）呼び声を上げたのだ。[1]
u.src: 38:3  How many generations have We destroyed before them, and they cried out when it was too late for deliverance.

ja: [1]　「悔悟が受け入れられない時」については、家畜章1５８とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 38:4  They wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves[3], and the disbelievers say, “This is a magician and a liar!

en: They wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves[3], and the disbelievers say, “This is a magician and a liar!
ja: また彼らは、自分たちのもとに自分たちの内から（人間の）警告者が到来したことに、驚いた。そして不信仰者*たちは、言ったのだ。「これは大嘘つきの魔術師だ。
u.src: 38:4  They wonder that a warner has come to them from among themselves[3], and the disbelievers say, “This is a magician and a liar!

en: [3] The disbelievers demanded that an angel be sent to them to convey the message of Allah, not a human like themselves.

p.src: 38:5  Has he made all gods into one God? Indeed, this is something strange!”

en: Has he made all gods into one God? Indeed, this is something strange!”
ja: 一体彼は、神々[1]を一つの神とする[2]というのか？本当にこれは、まさしく驚愕すべきこと」。
u.src: 38:5  Has he made all gods into one God? Indeed, this is something strange!”

ja: [1]　「神々」に関しては、雌牛章1３３の訳注を参照。 [2]　つまりアッラー*にいかなる同位者も置かず、かれだけを崇拝*することを命じた（アッ＝サァディー７０９頁参照）。

p.src: 38:6  The leaders among them departed, saying, “Carry on as you are, and stay faithful to your gods. Indeed, there is a motive behind it[4].

en: The leaders among them departed, saying, “Carry on as you are, and stay faithful to your gods. Indeed, there is a motive behind it[4].
ja: そして、彼らの内の有力者らが歩み出（て、民にこう言っ）た。「（そのままシルク*を）やり通し、あなた方の神々（の崇拝*）にしがみ付け。本当にこれはまさしく、仕組まれたこと[1]なのだ。
u.src: 38:6  The leaders among them departed, saying, “Carry on as you are, and stay faithful to your gods. Indeed, there is a motive behind it[4].

en: [4] i.e., The Prophet (ﷺ) only wants to gain influence and prestige for himself.
ja: [1]　預言者*ムハンマド*は、彼自身が権勢を得るために、その教えを広めようとしているのだということ（ムヤッサル４５３頁参照）。

p.src: 38:7  We have not heard of this in the last religion[5]. This is nothing but a fabrication.

en: We have not heard of this in the last religion[5]. This is nothing but a fabrication.
ja: 私たちはこのようなことを、最近の宗教[1]では聞いたことがない。これは捏造に外ならないのだ。
u.src: 38:7  We have not heard of this in the last religion[5]. This is nothing but a fabrication.

en: [5] It refers to Christianity or pagan Arab beliefs.
ja: [1]　一説にはクライシュ族*の宗教、また一説にはキリスト教（イブン・カスィール７：５５参照）。

p.src: 38:8  Has the Reminder been sent down to him from among us?” Rather, they are in doubt about My Reminder[6], for they have not yet tasted My punishment.

en: Has the Reminder been sent down to him from among us?” Rather, they are in doubt about My Reminder[6], for they have not yet tasted My punishment.
ja: 一体、私たちの間から（ムハンマド*が特別に選ばれて）、彼に教訓（クルアーン*）が下されたというのか？」いや、彼らはわが教訓（クルアーン*）に対して、疑念の中にある。いや、彼らはまだ我が懲罰を味わってはいない（から、そのようなことが言えるのだ）。
u.src: 38:8  Has the Reminder been sent down to him from among us?” Rather, they are in doubt about My Reminder[6], for they have not yet tasted My punishment.

en: [6] They do not question the Prophet's (ﷺ) honesty; rather, they question the Qur’an itself. See 6:33.

p.src: 38:9  Or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Bestower?

en: Or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Bestower?
ja: いや、一体彼らには、偉力ならびなく*、恵み深い*あなたの主*のご慈悲の宝庫があるというのか？
u.src: 38:9  Or do they possess the treasuries of the mercy of your Lord, the All-Mighty, the Bestower?

p.src: 38:10  Or do they have the dominion of the heavens and earth and all that is between them? Then let them ascend by any means[7].

en: Or do they have the dominion of the heavens and earth and all that is between them? Then let them ascend by any means[7].
ja: いや、一体彼らには、諸天と大地、その間にあるものの王権があるというのか？ならば、綱で（天へと）昇ってみさせよ。[1]
u.src: 38:10  Or do they have the dominion of the heavens and earth and all that is between them? Then let them ascend by any means[7].

en: [7] To manage the affairs of their dominion.
ja: [1]　彼らに天地の王権があり、そこにあるものを自由にできるというのなら、天に昇って本当にそうしてみよ、ということ（ムヤッサル４５３頁参照）。巡礼*章1５とその訳注も参照。

p.src: 38:11  This is only a small army[8] among several armies[9] that will soon be defeated.

en: This is only a small army[8] among several armies[9] that will soon be defeated.
ja: （彼らは、それ以前の不信仰な）徒党のように、そこ[1]で敗北することになる、たかが軍勢なのだから。
u.src: 38:11  This is only a small army[8] among several armies[9] that will soon be defeated.

en:
[8] It alludes to the defeat of the pagans of Makkah at Badr.
 [9] i.e., the defeated armies of the past who rejected their messengers.
ja: [1]　この「そこ」が何を指すかには、「彼らが陥っていた不信仰という立場」「天」「バドルの戦い*」んばどといった説がある（イブン・ジュザイ2：2４８参照）。

p.src: 38:12  The people of Noah rejected [their messengers] before them, as did ‘Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes[10];

en: The people of Noah rejected [their messengers] before them, as did ‘Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes[10];
ja: 彼ら以前にも、ヌーフ*の民、アード*、杭[1]の主フィルアウン*が、（使徒*たちを）噓つき呼ばわりした。
u.src: 38:12  The people of Noah rejected [their messengers] before them, as did ‘Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes[10];

en: [10] It refers to the stakes by which he used to torture people, or the pyramids which are like stakes into the earth.
ja: [1]　「杭」の解釈には、「完成度の高い建築物」「多くの建築物」「武力」「人を罰する時に用いていた杭のこと」「多くの軍勢」などといった説がある（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：1５４参照）。

p.src: 38:13  and Thamūd and the people of Lot, and the dwellers of the Forest – such were the [denier] parties.

en: and Thamūd and the people of Lot, and the dwellers of the Forest – such were the [denier] parties.
ja: またサムード*、ルート*の民、藪の仲間たち[1]も。それらの者たちは（不信仰の）徒党であった。
u.src: 38:13  and Thamūd and the people of Lot, and the dwellers of the Forest – such were the [denier] parties.

ja: [1]　「藪の仲間たち」については、アル＝ヒジュル章７８の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:14  Each of them rejected their messenger, therefore My punishment became inevitable.

en: Each of them rejected their messenger, therefore My punishment became inevitable.
ja: （彼ら）全員が、例外なく使徒*たちを噓つき呼ばわりし、それで（彼らへの）わが懲罰が確定したのである。
u.src: 38:14  Each of them rejected their messenger, therefore My punishment became inevitable.

p.src: 38:15  They are only waiting for a single Blast that cannot be stopped[11].

en: They are only waiting for a single Blast that cannot be stopped[11].
ja: そしてこれらの者たち（シルク*の徒）は、（シルク*に留まることで、轟く）一声（による懲罰）を待っているに過ぎない。そこには、帰り所などない。
u.src: 38:15  They are only waiting for a single Blast that cannot be stopped[11].

en: [11] Fawāq: "respite", more literally, "a period between two milkings of a she-camel," which also alludes to "return" or "repetition."

p.src: 38:16  They say, “Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of punishment] before the Day of Reckoning.”

en: They say, “Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of punishment] before the Day of Reckoning.”
ja: 彼らは言った。「我らが主*よ、清算の日の前に、私たちに取り分をお与えください」。[1]
u.src: 38:16  They say, “Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of punishment] before the Day of Reckoning.”

ja: [1]　懲罰。あるいは天国の享楽の一部を、現世で下してみよ、ということ。これは、不信仰者*らが嘲笑していった言葉（前掲書1５：1５７－1５８参照）。家畜章５７－５８、戦利品*章３2、ユーヌス*章５０、フード*章８、雷鳴章６、夜の旅章９2、巡礼*章４７、蜘蛛章５３－５４、相談章1８、階段章1－2なども参照。

p.src: 38:17  Bear with patience whatever they say, and remember Our slave David, the man of strength who constantly turned [to Allah].

en: Bear with patience whatever they say, and remember Our slave David, the man of strength who constantly turned [to Allah].
ja: （使徒*よ、）あなた[1]は彼らの言うことに耐え、つわもの[2]であったダーウード*を思い起こすのだ。実に彼は、常に回帰する者[3]であったのだから。
u.src: 38:17  Bear with patience whatever they say, and remember Our slave David, the man of strength who constantly turned [to Allah].

ja: [1]　この「あなた」については、雌牛章12０の訳注を参照。 [2] 「つわもの」とは、アッラー*の敵に対しては力強く、かれへの服従においては忍耐*強い者のこと（ムヤッサル４５４頁参照）。 [3]　「常に回帰する者」については、夜の旅章2５の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:18  We subjected the mountains to join him in glorifying Allah in the evening and the morning,

en: We subjected the mountains to join him in glorifying Allah in the evening and the morning,
ja: 本当にわれら*は、夕に朝に、彼（ダーウード*）と共に（アッラー*を）称える*山々を、仕えさせた。
u.src: 38:18  We subjected the mountains to join him in glorifying Allah in the evening and the morning,

p.src: 38:19  and the birds, in their flocks; they all would echo his praise.

en: and the birds, in their flocks; they all would echo his praise.
ja: また、集合させられた鳥たちも（、仕えさせた）。（その）全ては、かれ[1]に常に回帰する者であった。
u.src: 38:19  and the birds, in their flocks; they all would echo his praise.

ja: [1]　この「かれ」はアッラー*のこととも、ダーウード*のことであるともされる。一説に、山々や鳥たちは、ダーウード*がアッラー*を称える*たびに、それに応えて彼とともに称えた（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：1６1参照）。サバア章1０も参照。また「常に回帰する者」については、夜の旅章2５の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:20  We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and sound judgment [and speech].

en: We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and sound judgment [and speech].
ja: そして、われら*は彼の王権を強力にし、彼に英知と能弁さを授けた。
u.src: 38:20  We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and sound judgment [and speech].

p.src: 38:21  Has there come to you the story of the adversaries, when they climbed the wall of his chamber?

en: Has there come to you the story of the adversaries, when they climbed the wall of his chamber?
ja: また（使徒*よ、）あなたに論争（者たち）の消息は届いたか？彼ら（二人）がミフラーブ[1]を乗り越えて（、ダーウード*のところへ入って）来た時のこと。
u.src: 38:21  Has there come to you the story of the adversaries, when they climbed the wall of his chamber?

ja: [1]　「ミフラーブ」については、イムラーン家章３７の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:22  When they entered upon David, he was frightened. They said, “Do not be afraid. We are two adversaries: one of us has wronged the other, so judge between us with fairness, and do not be unjust, and guide us to the straight path.

en: When they entered upon David, he was frightened. They said, “Do not be afraid. We are two adversaries: one of us has wronged the other, so judge between us with fairness, and do not be unjust, and guide us to the straight path.
ja: 彼らがダーウード*のもとに入って来て、彼が慄いた時のこと。彼らは言った。「怖れてはいけません。（私たちは）論争中で、一方が他方を侵害しています。ですので真理によって私たちの間を裁き、誤ることなく、私たちを全うな道へとお導き下さい。
u.src: 38:22  When they entered upon David, he was frightened. They said, “Do not be afraid. We are two adversaries: one of us has wronged the other, so judge between us with fairness, and do not be unjust, and guide us to the straight path.

p.src: 38:23  This is my brother[12]. He has ninety-nine ewes while I have only one. He said, ‘Give her into my charge,’ and he overpowered me in speech.”

en: This is my brother[12]. He has ninety-nine ewes while I have only one. He said, ‘Give her into my charge,’ and he overpowered me in speech.”
ja: （一方の男は言った。）「実にこれは我が兄弟で、九十九頭の雌羊を所有していますが、私には一頭の雌羊しかいません。なのに彼は、『それを私に（よこして、）任せなさい』と言って、議論で私たちを打ち負かしたのです」。
u.src: 38:23  This is my brother[12]. He has ninety-nine ewes while I have only one. He said, ‘Give her into my charge,’ and he overpowered me in speech.”

en: [12] i.e., brother in faith, business partner, or biological brother.

p.src: 38:24  David said, “He has certainly wronged you by demanding that your ewe be added to his flock. Indeed, many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous deeds – and how few they are.” Then David realized that We were only testing him, so he asked his Lord for forgiveness[13], fell down in prostration, and turned to Him in repentance.

en: David said, “He has certainly wronged you by demanding that your ewe be added to his flock. Indeed, many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous deeds – and how few they are.” Then David realized that We were only testing him, so he asked his Lord for forgiveness[13], fell down in prostration, and turned to Him in repentance.
ja: 彼（ダーウード*）は言った。「彼（あなたの兄弟）は、あなたの一頭の雌羊を、彼の（九十九頭の）雌羊に（加えることを）要求することで、あなたに対して確かに不正*を働いた。そして実に共同者たちの多くは、信仰し、正しい行い*を行う者たちを除きーーそして彼らは数少ないのだーー、まさに互いに侵害し合うものなのである」。するとダーウード*は、われら*が彼を（その論争で）試練にかけたということを確信し、彼の主*にお赦しを乞い、ルクーゥ*しながら崩れ落ち、（アッラー*に悔悟して）立ち返った。（読誦のサジダ*）[1]
u.src: 38:24  David said, “He has certainly wronged you by demanding that your ewe be added to his flock. Indeed, many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous deeds – and how few they are.” Then David realized that We were only testing him, so he asked his Lord for forgiveness[13], fell down in prostration, and turned to Him in repentance.

en: [13] For fear of the two men or the misjudgment he made.
ja: [1]　イブン・カスィールによれば、多くの解釈学者らがこのアーヤ*に関して言及している諸説は、大半がクルアーン*以外の啓典由来の情報で、預言者*ムハンマド*にまで辿（たど）ることのできる真正*な伝承は一つとしてない。ゆえにこの話は読誦するだけに留めておき、その真の意図はアッラー*に委ねておくべきだ、としている（７：６０参照）。

p.src: 38:25  So We forgave that for him, and he certainly has a place of nearness to Us and a good place of return.

en: So We forgave that for him, and he certainly has a place of nearness to Us and a good place of return.
ja: それでわれら*は彼（ダーウード*）に、そのこと[1]を赦した。そして本当に彼にはまさしく、われら*のもとにおけるお近づきと、（来世における）善き戻り場所があるのだ。
u.src: 38:25  So We forgave that for him, and he certainly has a place of nearness to Us and a good place of return.

ja: [1]　アッラー*はその不必要性ゆえに、「そのこと」を明言されなかったのであり、それを追求するのは行き過ぎというものである。この話の意図はそもそも、ダーウード*の優しさと悔悟、そして悔悟の後にはそれ以前よりも優れた者となった、ということなのだから（アッ＝サァディー７11頁参照）。 また、預言者*の無謬（むびゅう）性については、雌牛章３６の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:26  “O David, We have made you a ruler on earth, so judge between people with justice, and do not follow your desires lest they lead you astray from Allah’s way. Those who go astray from Allah’s way will have a severe punishment because of their forgetting the Day of Reckoning.”

en: “O David, We have made you a ruler on earth, so judge between people with justice, and do not follow your desires lest they lead you astray from Allah’s way. Those who go astray from Allah’s way will have a severe punishment because of their forgetting the Day of Reckoning.”
ja: ダーウード*よ、本当にわれら*は、あなたを地上における継承者とした[1]。ゆえに、真理によって人々の間を裁くのだ。そして私欲に従って、自分をアッラー*の道から迷わせてはならない。本当にアッラー*の道から迷う者たちには、清算の日を忘れたことゆえの厳しい懲罰がある。
u.src: 38:26  “O David, We have made you a ruler on earth, so judge between people with justice, and do not follow your desires lest they lead you astray from Allah’s way. Those who go astray from Allah’s way will have a severe punishment because of their forgetting the Day of Reckoning.”

ja: [1]　アッラー*は彼を、善事を命じ、悪事を禁じる王とし、それ以前の預言者*・正しい導師たちの後を継がせられた（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：1８８参照）。

p.src: 38:27  We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve. So woe to the disbelievers from the Fire!

en: We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve. So woe to the disbelievers from the Fire!
ja: ーーわれら*は天と大地とその間にあるものを、無意味に創ったのではない[1]。それは不信仰に陥った者*たちの思い込みである。そして不信仰に陥った者*たちには、（地獄の）業火の災いあれ。
u.src: 38:27  We have not created the heavens and earth and all that is between them in vain. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve. So woe to the disbelievers from the Fire!

ja: [1]　イムラーン家章1９1の訳注も参照。

p.src: 38:28  Should We make those who believe and do righteous deeds equal to those who spread corruption on earth? Or should We make the righteous equal to the wicked?

en: Should We make those who believe and do righteous deeds equal to those who spread corruption on earth? Or should We make the righteous equal to the wicked?
ja: いや、一体われら*が、信仰して正しい行い*を行う者たちを、大地で腐敗*を働く者たちと同様にするとでも？いや、一体われら*が敬虔*な者たちを、放逸な者たちと同様にするというのか？
u.src: 38:28  Should We make those who believe and do righteous deeds equal to those who spread corruption on earth? Or should We make the righteous equal to the wicked?

p.src: 38:29  This is a blessed Book that We have sent down to you [O Prophet] so that they may reflect upon its verses, and so that people of understanding may take heed.

en: This is a blessed Book that We have sent down to you [O Prophet] so that they may reflect upon its verses, and so that people of understanding may take heed.
ja: （使徒*よ、このクルアーン*は）彼らがその御徴を熟慮し、澄んだ理性の持ち主らが教訓を得るべく、われら*があなたに下した啓典、祝福あふれたものであるーー。
u.src: 38:29  This is a blessed Book that We have sent down to you [O Prophet] so that they may reflect upon its verses, and so that people of understanding may take heed.

p.src: 38:30  And to David We gave Solomon, an excellent and faithful slave who constantly turned [to Us].

en: And to David We gave Solomon, an excellent and faithful slave who constantly turned [to Us].
ja: われら*はダーウード*に、（その息子）スライマーン*を授けた。僕（スライマーン*）の素晴らしいことよ、本当に彼は常に回帰する者[1]なのだから。
u.src: 38:30  And to David We gave Solomon, an excellent and faithful slave who constantly turned [to Us].

ja: [1]　「常に回帰する者」については、夜の旅章2５の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:31  One evening, well-trained and swift horses of noble breed were presented before him.

en: One evening, well-trained and swift horses of noble breed were presented before him.
ja: 彼（スライマーン*）に夕の頃、優良な駿馬[1]が見せられた時のこと（を思い起させよ）。
u.src: 38:31  One evening, well-trained and swift horses of noble breed were presented before him.

ja: [1]　「駿馬」と意訳した語「サーフィナート」は、馬のみに用いられる能動分詞の複数形。止まっている時に三本足で立ち、四本目の足は爪先立ちしている様子のこと。敏捷（びんしょう）さを示す印とされる（イブン・アーシュール2３：2５５参照）。

p.src: 38:32  He then said, “I gave preference to the love of fine things over the remembrance of my Lord,” until the sun went out of sight.

en: He then said, “I gave preference to the love of fine things over the remembrance of my Lord,” until the sun went out of sight.
ja: そして彼（スライマーン*）は、言った。「本当に私は、（太陽が）覆いに包まれる[1]まで、我が主*の唱念をよそに、財産[2]への愛情を傾けてしまった。[3]
u.src: 38:32  He then said, “I gave preference to the love of fine things over the remembrance of my Lord,” until the sun went out of sight.

ja: [1]　つまり日没のこと（ムヤッサル４５５頁参照）。 [2]　この「財産」は、馬のこと（前掲書、同頁参照）。 [3]　解釈学者たちはこの出来事を、スライマーン*が馬の鑑賞に熱中して、アスル*の礼拝を忘れてしまったのだとしている（イブン・カスィール７：６５参照）。預言者*の無謬（むびゅう）性については、雌牛章３６の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:33  [He ordered], “Bring them back to me,” and he began striking [their] shanks and necks[14].

en: [He ordered], “Bring them back to me,” and he began striking [their] shanks and necks[14].
ja: それら（馬）を私のもとに、また連れて来い」。そして（馬が連れて来られると、）彼は（剣で）その足と首を打ち始めた。[1]
u.src: 38:33  [He ordered], “Bring them back to me,” and he began striking [their] shanks and necks[14].

en: [14] With his sword as expiation, for it might have been permissible in their law, especially if it had been for the sake of Allah such as missing prayer or the like; this is a more correct view. However, Ibn Jarīr favored the view that Solomon began to rub down their legs and necks with the hand, not by the sword.
ja: [1]　馬を殺したのではなく、愛情をもってたてがみと足を撫（な）でた、という解釈もある（アッ＝タバリー８：７０００参照）。

p.src: 38:34  Indeed, We tested Solomon and cast upon his throne a body, then he turned [to Allah][15].

en: Indeed, We tested Solomon and cast upon his throne a body, then he turned [to Allah][15].
ja: また、われら*はスライマーン*を試練にかけ、その椅子に（死）体を投げた[1]。それから彼は、（アッラー*に悔悟して）立ち返ったのだ。
u.src: 38:34  Indeed, We tested Solomon and cast upon his throne a body, then he turned [to Allah][15].

en: [15] The Prophet (ﷺ) said that one night Solomon said that each one of his wives would conceive a boy who would fight for the sake of Allah. He forgot to say ‘Allah willing,’ so only one of them gave birth to a deformed, dead baby. So Solomon sought Allah’s forgiveness. [Al-Bukhāri]
ja: [1]　スライマーン*はある時、自分が全員の妻と交わり、その結果、彼女ら全員はアッラー*の道ゆえに戦う騎士（きし）を産むのだと誓ったが、その際「もしアッラー*がお望みならば」と付け加えなかった（洞窟章2３－2４とその訳注も参照）。その結果、彼の妻たちの内、妊娠したのは一人だけで、しかも彼女が産んだのは未熟児だったという（アル＝ブハーリー６６３９参照）。

p.src: 38:35  He said, “My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom, the like of which will never be granted to anyone after me. You are indeed the Bestower.”

en: He said, “My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom, the like of which will never be granted to anyone after me. You are indeed the Bestower.”
ja: 彼（スライマーン*）は言った。「我が主*よ、私をお赦し下さい。そして私の後の（人間の内、）誰にも相応しくないような（偉大な）王権を、私にお授け下さい。本当にあなたこそは、恵み深い*お方なのですから」。
u.src: 38:35  He said, “My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom, the like of which will never be granted to anyone after me. You are indeed the Bestower.”

p.src: 38:36  So We subjected to him the wind blowing gently by his command to wherever he wished,

en: So We subjected to him the wind blowing gently by his command to wherever he wished,
ja: また、われら*は彼（スライマーン*）に、彼の命令によって、彼の意図した場所へと走る、穏やかな風[1]を仕えさせた。
u.src: 38:36  So We subjected to him the wind blowing gently by his command to wherever he wished,

ja: [1]　風はスライマーン*の思い通りに、強くなったり、穏やかになったりした（アル＝バガウィー３：３０1参照）。預言者*たち章８1、サバア章12も参照。

p.src: 38:37  And [We subjected to him] the devils, all kinds of builders and divers[16],

en: And [We subjected to him] the devils, all kinds of builders and divers[16],
ja: また、シャイターン*たち、つまり（彼の命令に従う）あらゆる建設家、潜水夫[1]を（仕えさせた）。
u.src: 38:37  And [We subjected to him] the devils, all kinds of builders and divers[16],

en: [16] They dived to bring him pearls.
ja: [1]　サバア章1３で示されているようなものを建設・作成する者たちや、海に潜って真珠や宝石などを採集する者たちのこと（イブン・カスィール７：７３参照）。

p.src: 38:38  and others bound in chains.

en: and others bound in chains.
ja: そして、枷でがんじがらめにされている、別の者たち[1]を。
u.src: 38:38  and others bound in chains.

ja: [1]　これはシャイターン*の内でも、反抗的な者たちのこととされる（ムヤッサル４５５頁参照）。

p.src: 38:39  [We said], “This is Our gift, so give freely or withhold, without account[17].”

en: [We said], “This is Our gift, so give freely or withhold, without account[17].”
ja: これは（スライマーン*への）、われら*の贈り物。ならば（望む者には）際限なく恵み、あるいは（望むものには）禁じるがよい。
u.src: 38:39  [We said], “This is Our gift, so give freely or withhold, without account[17].”

en: [17] i.e., you will not be called to account thereby.

p.src: 38:40  And he certainly has a status of nearness to Us and a good place of return.

en: And he certainly has a status of nearness to Us and a good place of return.
ja: そして本当に彼（スライマーン*）にはまさしく、われら*のもとにおける近侍と、（来世における）善き戻り場所があるのだ。
u.src: 38:40  And he certainly has a status of nearness to Us and a good place of return.

p.src: 38:41  And remember Our slave Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Indeed, Satan has afflicted me with hardship and pain.”

en: And remember Our slave Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Indeed, Satan has afflicted me with hardship and pain.”
ja: われら*の僕、アイユーブ*を思い出せ。彼がその主*に、「シャイターン*は疲労と罰[1]で、私を襲いました」と呼びかけた時のこと。
u.src: 38:41  And remember Our slave Job, when he cried out to his Lord, “Indeed, Satan has afflicted me with hardship and pain.”

ja: [1]　アイユーブ*はシャイターン*により、自分の体、財産、家族において甚大（じんだい）な被害を受けたとされる（ムヤッサル４５５頁参照）。

p.src: 38:42  [Allah said], “Stamp [the ground] with your foot: here is a cool spring for bathing and drinking.”

en: [Allah said], “Stamp [the ground] with your foot: here is a cool spring for bathing and drinking.”
ja: （われら*は言った。）「あなたの足で（地面を）蹴るがよい」。（そしてその通りにすると、水が噴き出た。）「これは冷たい洗浄水であり、飲み物である」。[1]
u.src: 38:42  [Allah said], “Stamp [the ground] with your foot: here is a cool spring for bathing and drinking.”

ja: [1]　彼がそれを飲み、それで体を洗うと、彼を苦しめていた害悪は消え去った（前掲書、同頁参照）。

p.src: 38:43  And We restored his family to him and the like of them[18] as a mercy from Us and as a reminder for people of understanding.

en: And We restored his family to him and the like of them[18] as a mercy from Us and as a reminder for people of understanding.
ja: また、われら*は彼にその家族と、更にそれと同様のもの[1]を授けた。われら*からの慈悲と、澄んだ理性の持ち主たちへの教訓[2]として。
u.src: 38:43  And We restored his family to him and the like of them[18] as a mercy from Us and as a reminder for people of understanding.

en: [18] When Allah granted him health, the whole family returned to him and he was granted even more children.
ja: [1]　この「同様のもの」については、預言者*たち章８４の訳注を参照。 [2]　忍耐*の後には、慰（なぐさ）めと、害悪の解消があるという「教訓」（前掲書４５６頁参照）。

p.src: 38:44  [We said], “Take a bunch of grass in your hand, and strike [your wife] with it, and do not break your oath[19].” We truly found him patient – an excellent and faithful slave he was. He constantly turned [to Us].

en: [We said], “Take a bunch of grass in your hand, and strike [your wife] with it, and do not break your oath[19].” We truly found him patient – an excellent and faithful slave he was. He constantly turned [to Us].
ja: （われら*は言った。）「そして手に（草の）一束を採り、それでそれ（妻）をたたき、（誓いを）破るのではない[1]」。実にわれら*は、彼が忍耐*する者であることを認めた。僕（アイユーブ*）の素晴らしいことよ、本当に彼は常に回帰する者[2]なのだから。
u.src: 38:44  [We said], “Take a bunch of grass in your hand, and strike [your wife] with it, and do not break your oath[19].” We truly found him patient – an excellent and faithful slave he was. He constantly turned [to Us].

en: [19] When Job was afflicted with illness, everyone abandoned him except his wife. Once he became angry with her and vowed to punish her with one hundred lashes if he recovered. According to Allah's instruction, the oath was fulfilled by striking her once with one hundred blades of grass without harming his wife.
ja: [1]　アイユーブ*は病に苦しんでいる時、些細（ささい）なことで妻のことを怒り、もしアッラー*が彼の病を治して下さったら、彼女を鞭（むち）で百回打つ、と誓った。ただし彼女は正しい女性だったので、アッラー*はその誓いをアーヤ*で言及されている行為によって免じられ、彼と彼女を慈しまれたのだという（前掲書、同頁参照）。預言者*の無謬（むびゅう）性については、雌牛章３６の訳注を参照。 [2]　「常に回帰する者」については、夜の旅章2５の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:45  Remember Our slaves: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob – men of strength and insight.

en: Remember Our slaves: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob – men of strength and insight.
ja: また、われら*の僕たち、つわもの[1]で、慧眼の主だったイブラーヒーム*、イスハーク*、ヤァクーブ*を思い出せ。
u.src: 38:45  Remember Our slaves: Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob – men of strength and insight.

ja: [1]　「つわもの」については、アーヤ*1７の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:46  We chose them exclusively for the remembrance of the Final Home.

en: We chose them exclusively for the remembrance of the Final Home.
ja: 本当にわれら*は彼らを（偉大なる）特性、つまり（来世の）住まいの唱念で、精錬した[1]。
u.src: 38:46  We chose them exclusively for the remembrance of the Final Home.

ja: [1]　つまり来世をよく想起し、来世のために現世で努力し、アッラー*に服従し、かれを意識して行動する者とした、ということ。自分だけではなく他人のことも、アッラー*と来世について想起させる者、という意味も含まれ得る（アッ＝タバリー８：７０1８参照）。

p.src: 38:47  Indeed, they are before us among the chosen and best ones.

en: Indeed, they are before us among the chosen and best ones.
ja: また本当に彼らはわれら*のもとで、（啓示の伝達のために）まさに選び抜かれた者たち、（われら*への服従のために）選ばれし者たちである。
u.src: 38:47  Indeed, they are before us among the chosen and best ones.

p.src: 38:48  Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhul-Kifl[20] – all were among the best.

en: Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhul-Kifl[20] – all were among the best.
ja: また、イスマーイール*とアル＝ヤサァ*とズル＝キフル*を思い出せ。（彼らは）皆、選ばれし者たちである。
u.src: 38:48  Also remember Ishmael, Elisha, and Dhul-Kifl[20] – all were among the best.

en: [20] Scholars are of different opinions as to whether Dhul-Kifl was a prophet or only a righteous man.

p.src: 38:49  This is a reminder. And the righteous will surely have a good return:

en: This is a reminder. And the righteous will surely have a good return:
ja: これ(クルアーン*）は、訓戒[1]。本当に敬虔*な者たちには、実によい戻り所がある、
u.src: 38:49  This is a reminder. And the righteous will surely have a good return:

ja: [1]　栄誉、という解釈もある（アル＝バガウィー７：７４参照）。金の装飾章４４も参照。

p.src: 38:50  Gardens of Eternity, with gates wide open for them.

en: Gardens of Eternity, with gates wide open for them.
ja: 彼らに向けて門が開かれた、永久の楽園が。
u.src: 38:50  Gardens of Eternity, with gates wide open for them.

p.src: 38:51  They will recline therein, calling for abundant fruit and drink.

en: They will recline therein, calling for abundant fruit and drink.
ja: 彼らはそこで、（寝台に）寄りかかっている。そこで（望むだけの）たくさんの果実と飲み物を、持って来させつつ。
u.src: 38:51  They will recline therein, calling for abundant fruit and drink.

p.src: 38:52  And they will have maidens of modest gaze[21] and equal age.

en: And they will have maidens of modest gaze[21] and equal age.
ja: また彼らのもとには、同い年の、（自分の夫だけに）視線を定めた女性[1]たちがいる。
u.src: 38:52  And they will have maidens of modest gaze[21] and equal age.

en: [21] Their gaze will be restricted to their mates alone.
ja: [1]　「視線を定めた女性」については、整列者章４８の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:53  This is what you are promised for the Day of Account.

en: This is what you are promised for the Day of Account.
ja: （敬虔*な者たちよ、）これが清算の日に、あなた方が約束されているもの。
u.src: 38:53  This is what you are promised for the Day of Account.

p.src: 38:54  Indeed, this is Our provision [for the righteous] that will never cease.

en: Indeed, this is Our provision [for the righteous] that will never cease.
ja: 実にこれはまさしく、（あなた方への）われらの糧。そこに決して終わりはない。
u.src: 38:54  Indeed, this is Our provision [for the righteous] that will never cease.

p.src: 38:55  This [is so]. But the transgressors will surely have the worst return:

en: This [is so]. But the transgressors will surely have the worst return:
ja: これは（、敬虔*な者たちのためのもの）。実に（不信仰において）度を越した者たちには、本当に悪い戻り場所がある、
u.src: 38:55  This [is so]. But the transgressors will surely have the worst return:

p.src: 38:56  Hell, where they will burn. What a terrible resting place!

en: Hell, where they will burn. What a terrible resting place!
ja: 彼らが入って炙られることになる、地獄が。その寝床は何と醜悪であろうか。
u.src: 38:56  Hell, where they will burn. What a terrible resting place!

p.src: 38:57  Let them taste this: scalding water and pus,

en: Let them taste this: scalding water and pus,
ja: これはーー彼らにそれを味わわせよーー、煮えたぎる湯と膿汁[1]。
u.src: 38:57  Let them taste this: scalding water and pus,

ja: [1]　「膿汁」と訳した語「ガッサーク」の解釈には、「強烈な異臭の膿」「極限まで冷やされた冷水」「毒の泉の名称」「地獄の民の体液」などの諸説がある（アル＝クルトゥビー1５：221－222参照）。

p.src: 38:58  and other similar [torments] of various kinds.

en: and other similar [torments] of various kinds.
ja: また、それと同様の別のものが、各種ある。
u.src: 38:58  and other similar [torments] of various kinds.

p.src: 38:59  [The misleaders will say], “Here is a crowd of people being thrown in with you. They are not welcome! They will surely burn in the Fire.”

en: [The misleaders will say], “Here is a crowd of people being thrown in with you. They are not welcome! They will surely burn in the Fire.”
ja: （地獄の民は、別の集団がそこに入って来ると、お互いに言う[1]。）「これは、あなた方と共に（地獄に）飛び込んで来る集団だ」。「彼らの疎ましいこと。本当に彼らは（私たちと同様に、）業火に入って炙られるのだから」。
u.src: 38:59  [The misleaders will say], “Here is a crowd of people being thrown in with you. They are not welcome! They will surely burn in the Fire.”

ja: [1]　あるいは、最初の言葉は地獄の番人で、次の言葉は不信仰へと主導した有力者たちのもの（前掲書1５：22３参照）。

p.src: 38:60  They will say, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this on us. What a terrible place to settle in!”

en: They will say, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this on us. What a terrible place to settle in!”
ja: 彼ら（既に地獄に入っている集団に倣って不信仰者*となった、後から地獄に入って来た集団）は、（自分たちを不信仰へと主導した集団に）言う。「いや、あなた方こそ疎ましいこと。あなた方がそれを、私たちに提供したのだから[1]。その留まり所は、何と醜悪であろうか。
u.src: 38:60  They will say, “No! You are not welcome! You brought this on us. What a terrible place to settle in!”

ja: [1]　あなた方は現世で私たちを迷わすことで、私たちに地獄の住まいを提供したのだ、という意味（ムヤッサル４５６頁参照）。同様の情景の描写として、雌牛章1６６－1６７、高壁章３８、イブラーヒーム*章21－22、識別章1７－1９、物語章６３、部族連合唱６７－６８、サバア章３1－３３も参照。

p.src: 38:61  They will say, “Our Lord, whoever brought this on us, give him double punishment in the Fire.”

en: They will say, “Our Lord, whoever brought this on us, give him double punishment in the Fire.”
ja: 彼ら（後から地獄に入って来た集団）は、言う。「我らが主*よ、私たちにこれを提供した者には、業火の中で倍の懲罰を上乗せして下さい」。
u.src: 38:61  They will say, “Our Lord, whoever brought this on us, give him double punishment in the Fire.”

p.src: 38:62  They will say, “Why do we not see those whom we considered to be among the wicked[22]?

en: They will say, “Why do we not see those whom we considered to be among the wicked[22]?
ja: 彼ら（地獄の民の内、暴虐な不信仰だった者*たち）は、言う。「私たちが、（現世で）ろくでなしと見なしていた男たち[1]を（ここで）見かけないのは、どうしたことだ？
u.src: 38:62  They will say, “Why do we not see those whom we considered to be among the wicked[22]?

en: [22] They are alluding to the believers.
ja: [1]　信仰者たちのこと（アッ＝サァディー７1６頁参照）。

p.src: 38:63  Is it that we mistakenly made fun of them, or do our eyes fail to see them [in the Fire]?”

en: Is it that we mistakenly made fun of them, or do our eyes fail to see them [in the Fire]?”
ja: 一体、私たちは彼らを（誤って）嘲笑の的にしていたのか？それとも（彼らは地獄にいるのに、私たちの）目は彼らから逸らされてしまったのか？[1]」
u.src: 38:63  Is it that we mistakenly made fun of them, or do our eyes fail to see them [in the Fire]?”

ja: [1]　あるいは、「本当に彼らは自分たちより優れていたのに、現世でそれを見落としてしまったのか？」という意味（アル＝バガウィー４：７６参照）。

p.src: 38:64  This is certainly true that the people of the Fire will dispute among themselves.

en: This is certainly true that the people of the Fire will dispute among themselves.
ja: 実にそれは、まさしく真実なのである。（それは）地獄の民の議論なのだ。
u.src: 38:64  This is certainly true that the people of the Fire will dispute among themselves.

p.src: 38:65  Say [O Prophet], “I am only a warner, and none has the right to be worshiped except Allah, the One, the Subjugator,

en: Say [O Prophet], “I am only a warner, and none has the right to be worshiped except Allah, the One, the Subjugator,
ja: （使徒*よ、）言え。「本当に私は一人の警告者である。そして唯一の*お方、君臨し給う*お方であるアッラー*の外に、崇拝*すべきいかなるものもない。
u.src: 38:65  Say [O Prophet], “I am only a warner, and none has the right to be worshiped except Allah, the One, the Subjugator,

p.src: 38:66  Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty[23], Most Forgiving[24].”

en: Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty[23], Most Forgiving[24].”
ja: 諸天と大地と、その間にあるものの主*、偉力ならびない*お方、赦し深いお方である（アッラー*の外には）」。
u.src: 38:66  Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, the All-Mighty[23], Most Forgiving[24].”

en:
[23] Honored for absolute power, wisdom, and justice.
 [24] Who repeatedly conceals the sins of His slaves.

p.src: 38:67  Say, “This [Qur’an] is of momentous news

en: Say, “This [Qur’an] is of momentous news
ja: （使徒*よ、民に）言ってやれ。「これ（クルアーン*）は偉大なる消息。
u.src: 38:67  Say, “This [Qur’an] is of momentous news

p.src: 38:68  from which you are turning away.”

en: from which you are turning away.”
ja: あなた方はそこから背を向けているが。
u.src: 38:68  from which you are turning away.”

p.src: 38:69  [And say], “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [about Adam][25].

en: [And say], “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [about Adam][25].
ja: 私には、最上界の貴人（天使）たちが（アーダム*の創造に関して）議論している時[1]の知識など、なかったのである。
u.src: 38:69  [And say], “I had no knowledge of the highest assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [about Adam][25].

en: [25] When the angels obeyed Allah’s command to prostrate before Adam; whereas, Satan refused to comply, for he considered himself superior to Adam, neglecting the fact that this was a command from Allah Almighty.
ja: [1]　この内容は、アーヤ*７1以降に描写されている出来事のこと（イブン・カスィール７：８1参照）。

p.src: 38:70  I have only received revelation in order to give a clear warning.”

en: I have only received revelation in order to give a clear warning.”
ja: 私に啓示が下されるのは、まさに私が明白なる警告者であるゆえに外ならない」。
u.src: 38:70  I have only received revelation in order to give a clear warning.”

p.src: 38:71  [Remember] when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay.

en: [Remember] when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay.
ja: あなたの主*が天使*たちに、（こう）仰せられた時のこと（を思い起こさせよ）[1]。「本当にわれは、泥土[2]から人間を創る者である。
u.src: 38:71  [Remember] when your Lord said to the angels, “I am going to create a human being from clay.

ja: [1]　この出来事の詳細に関しては、雌牛章３４－３９、高壁章11－2５、アル＝ヒジュル章2８－４2、夜の旅章６1－６５、ター・ハー章11６－12３も参照。 [2]　アーダム*が土から段階を経（へ）て創られたことについては、アル＝ヒジュル章2６の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:72  When I completed his creation and breathed into him of My spirit[26], fall down in prostration to him.”

en: When I completed his creation and breathed into him of My spirit[26], fall down in prostration to him.”
ja: それでわれら*がそれを整え、そこにわが魂[1]より吹き込んだら、彼（アーダム*）に向かってサジダ[2]せよ」。
u.src: 38:72  When I completed his creation and breathed into him of My spirit[26], fall down in prostration to him.”

en: [26] See footnote 15:29.
ja: [1]　「わが魂」については、アル＝ヒジュル章2９の訳注を参照。 [2]　このサジダ*については、雌牛章３４の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:73  Then the angels fell down in prostration all together,

en: Then the angels fell down in prostration all together,
ja: それで天使*たちは皆、一斉にサジダ*した。
u.src: 38:73  Then the angels fell down in prostration all together,

p.src: 38:74  except Iblīs, who was arrogant and became one of the disbelievers[27].

en: except Iblīs, who was arrogant and became one of the disbelievers[27].
ja: 但し、イブリース*だけは別だった。かれは高慢だったのであり、不信仰者*の類いだったのだ。
u.src: 38:74  except Iblīs, who was arrogant and became one of the disbelievers[27].

en: [27] This command of Allah to bow down before Adam was a test of obedience. Satan refused to comply out of arrogance for he thought he was better than Adam.

p.src: 38:75  [Allah] said, “O Iblīs, what prevented you from prostrating to whom I created with My two Hands? Did you just become proud or have you always been arrogant?”

en: [Allah] said, “O Iblīs, what prevented you from prostrating to whom I created with My two Hands? Did you just become proud or have you always been arrogant?”
ja: かれ（アッラー*）は仰せられた。「イブリース*よ、わが両手によって創造した[1]ものに対し、あなたがサジダ*するのを妨げたのは、何なのか？一体あなたは（アーダム*に対し）高慢だったのか、それとも（われに対して）奢り高ぶる者たちの類いだったのか？」
u.src: 38:75  [Allah] said, “O Iblīs, what prevented you from prostrating to whom I created with My two Hands? Did you just become proud or have you always been arrogant?”

ja: [1]　アッラー*はこうすることでアーダム*を、他のいかなる創造物に対しても与えられなかった栄誉を授けられた（アッ＝サァディー７1６頁参照）。

p.src: 38:76  He said, “I am better than him: You created me from fire and created him from clay.”

en: He said, “I am better than him: You created me from fire and created him from clay.”
ja: 彼（イブリース*）は申し上げた。「私は彼（アーダム*）よりも優れています。あなたは私を火からお創りになり、彼のことは泥土からお創りになったのですから」。[1]
u.src: 38:76  He said, “I am better than him: You created me from fire and created him from clay.”

ja: [1]　このイブリース*の言葉については、高壁章12の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:77  [Allah] said, “Then get out of here, for you are accursed,

en: [Allah] said, “Then get out of here, for you are accursed,
ja: かれ（アッラー*）は、仰せられた。「ならば、そこ（楽園）から出て行くがよい。まさにあなたは、追放された[1]者なのだ。
u.src: 38:77  [Allah] said, “Then get out of here, for you are accursed,

ja: [1]　「追放された」については、イムラーン家章３６の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:78  and My curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”

en: and My curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”
ja: そして本当にあなたの上には、報いの日*まで、我が呪い[1]がある」。
u.src: 38:78  and My curse will be upon you until the Day of Judgment.”

ja: [1]　アッラー*の「呪い」については、雌牛章８８の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:79  He said, “My Lord, then give me respite until the Day of their resurrection.”

en: He said, “My Lord, then give me respite until the Day of their resurrection.”
ja: 彼（イブリース*）は、申し上げた。「我が主*よ、それなら私に、彼らが蘇らされる日まで猶予をお授け下さい」。
u.src: 38:79  He said, “My Lord, then give me respite until the Day of their resurrection.”

p.src: 38:80  Allah said, “You are given respite,

en: Allah said, “You are given respite,
ja: かれ（アッラー*）は仰せられた。「それでは、実にあなたは猶予される者の一人である。[1]
u.src: 38:80  Allah said, “You are given respite,

ja: [1]　イブリース*の申し出が受け入れられたことについては、高壁章1５の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:81  until the Day of the appointed time.”

en: until the Day of the appointed time.”
ja: 定められた（復活*の）時の日まで」。
u.src: 38:81  until the Day of the appointed time.”

p.src: 38:82  Iblīs said, “By Your Glory, I will surely mislead them all,

en: Iblīs said, “By Your Glory, I will surely mislead them all,
ja: 彼（イブリース*）は申し上げた。「では、あなたのご偉力に誓って、私は必ずや彼ら（人類）を全員、踏み誤らせてみせましょう。
u.src: 38:82  Iblīs said, “By Your Glory, I will surely mislead them all,

p.src: 38:83  except for Your chosen slaves among them.”

en: except for Your chosen slaves among them.”
ja: 但し、彼らの内、精選されたあなたの僕たち[1]はその限りではありませんが」。
u.src: 38:83  except for Your chosen slaves among them.”

ja: [1]　「精選されたアッラー*の僕」については、ユースフ*章2４の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:84  Allah said, “Such is the truth – and I only say the truth –

en: Allah said, “Such is the truth – and I only say the truth –
ja: かれ（アッラー*）は仰せられた。「真実こそ（、わが誓い）。そして真実をこそ、われは語る。
u.src: 38:84  Allah said, “Such is the truth – and I only say the truth –

p.src: 38:85  that I will certainly fill Hell with you and those of them who follow you all together.”

en: that I will certainly fill Hell with you and those of them who follow you all together.”
ja: われは必ずや地獄を、あなた（イブリース*）と、彼ら（人類）の内であなたに従った者全員で、満たそう」。
u.src: 38:85  that I will certainly fill Hell with you and those of them who follow you all together.”

p.src: 38:86  Say [O Prophet], “I do not ask you for any reward for it, nor do I pretend to be what I am not.

en: Say [O Prophet], “I do not ask you for any reward for it, nor do I pretend to be what I am not.
ja: （使徒*よ、）言うがよい。「私はそのことゆえに、あなた方に見返り[1]を求めているわけではないし、無理（して預言者*を自称）する者の類いでもない。
u.src: 38:86  Say [O Prophet], “I do not ask you for any reward for it, nor do I pretend to be what I am not.

ja: [1]　この「見返り」については、家畜章９０の訳注を参照。

p.src: 38:87  It is only a reminder for all people[28].

en: It is only a reminder for all people[28].
ja: それ（クルアーン*）は、全創造物への教訓に外ならないのだ。
u.src: 38:87  It is only a reminder for all people[28].

en: [28] Of jinn and men.

p.src: 38:88  And you will surely know its truth after a while.”

en: And you will surely know its truth after a while.”
ja: そしてあなた方はきっと、しばらく後にその消息[1]を知ることになろう」。
u.src: 38:88  And you will surely know its truth after a while.”

ja: [1]　この「消息」とは、クルアーン*の伝える内容と、その正しさのこと。彼ら不信仰者*はイスラーム*が栄え、人々が一斉に改宗する時、あるいは実際に彼らを懲罰が襲い、取り返しがつかなくなる時になって、それを認めることとなる（ムヤッサル４５８頁参照）。
